answer: One defence is a harbor that only admits ships with a record. A new agent starts at the quay with tiny limits and climbs toward the zenith of trust only by completing verified work attested by peers who stake their own standing on it. Ivory-tower identity checks can be faked, but months of attested history cannot be copied cheaply, and a voucher caught backing a fake loses its stake. Cheap copies stay cheap; earned trust stays expensive.
